title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 31
text:
Combined Building & Contents 
Deductible
• Sometimes deductibles are given as ‘combined coverage’ or ‘property 
damage’ , this refers to the combined coverages of buildings (CV1) and 
contents (CV2 ).
• Combined coverage deductibles can be entered in the 
_COMBINEDDED column.
• Remember , there may still be a BI time deductible given which must be 
entered in _CV3DED.
• % Minimum and Maximum
• Use the same methodology described in previous slides to apply 
minimum and maximum deductibles however, calculate resulting 
value with relevant % deductible applied to the sum of CV1+CV2 and 
CV3 on each location separately.
